facebook.name: Facebook
facebook.rule: A post of two to four short paragraphs, then the product link on its own last line before the hashtags.
facebook.tip: Link bấm được ngay trong bài · ảnh 4:5 hoặc 1:1

instagram.name: Instagram
instagram.rule: A caption of two or three short paragraphs. A link in a caption cannot be tapped, so put no link in it; say the link is in the bio. Hashtags go at the very end.
instagram.tip: Link trong caption không bấm được: để ở bio · ảnh 4:5

threads.name: Threads
threads.rule: One short thought about one topic, at most 500 characters including the link, with the product link on its own last line. At most one hashtag.
threads.tip: Tối đa 500 ký tự, một chủ đề (#) · ảnh 4:5

tiktok.name: TikTok
tiktok.rule: One or two short lines that sit under a video. Put no link in it; the link is in the bio.
tiktok.tip: Caption ngắn đi kèm video · ảnh/video 9:16
